name: rod-listener-https
description: The official https listener: the envelope POST, the WebSocket beacon, the plain-http variant, and hook, lure, and artifact forwarding over the listener bridge.

opsec.notes: Operator-side infrastructure, not target-side: the package lands as a static binary tree under the teamserver's module store and runs as a supervised child on the same host (or a future edge host), binding one HTTP(S) front per listener. On the wire it is an ordinary web server -- one port, server TLS when the front says so (leaf issued by the engagement CA, handed over as a user-only PEM), no client certificate anywhere. The process itself parses no rod.v1 grammar, holds no engagement key, and learns no implant identity; contacts stay sealed end to end under the per-artifact key the kernel never shares with it.
